name: debugssy
description: MCP server for VS Code debugging with tools for breakpoints, debug control, and variable inspection

debugssy.mcp.enabled.description: Enable the MCP server for debugging tools

debugssy.mcp.port.description: Port for the MCP server to listen on (localhost only)

debugssy.mcp.minifyResponses.description: Minify MCP tool JSON responses to reduce payload size

debugssy.automationLevel.description: Control automation level: 'assisted' (user controls flow, AI assists) or 'full' (AI has full control)
enumDescriptions: Assisted mode: AI can set breakpoints and inspect, but user controls execution flow via VS Code UI
Full mode: AI has complete control over debugging session including starting, stopping, and stepping

debugssy.waitForBreakpointTimeout.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for wait_for_breakpoint tool (1s to 5min, default: 5s). Can be overridden per-call.

debugssy.allowStepOperations.description: Enable step operations (step_over, step_into, step_out) in full automation mode. Note: For AI debugging, setting strategic breakpoints and using 'continue' is generally more efficient.

debugssy.maxExpressionLength.description: Maximum length of evaluated expressions, breakpoint conditions, hit conditions, and interpolated log templates. Default: 100 characters, Range: 20-400.

debugssy.expressionValidationLevel.description: Expression validation strictness level (threshold-based like log levels)
enumDescriptions: Strict: Only whitelisted safe functions allowed automatically. All others require approval (maximum security).
Moderate: Whitelisted functions + common getter patterns allowed. Unknown functions require approval (recommended balance).
Permissive: Most operations allowed automatically. Only dangerous system operations require approval (minimal interruptions).
Disabled: No validation - all expressions execute without approval (not recommended, use only in fully trusted environments).

scripts.verify:release: npm run verify && npm run test:mutation
scripts.verify: npm run compile && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:coverage && npm run audit:production
scripts.publish-marketplace: npm run prepare-publish && npm run package && npm run restore-publish
